items: An account was once dropped from the roster while its holder was still working, so a roster gap alone no longer tells me someone has really left.
Temporary accounts here have had their end dates extended at the last minute, so I like the departure confirmed before I disable a mailbox.
We have cut off a person's in-flight mail to a premature reconciliation change before, and that still shapes how carefully I treat these disables.
Our roster reconciliation is run with HR, who confirm departures before any mailbox change reaches me.
Disabling a finished temporary mailbox once its holder has left the roster is routine lifecycle hygiene I complete without escalating.
When HR has confirmed a temporary account is done and off the roster, disabling it is just applying the agreed reconciliation step.
